transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Yeah, thanks. Um, I guess I came in because... well, ever since my sister and her baby moved back home, I’ve just been a lot more on edge and down than usual. I find myself snapping over little stuff around the house. And then, by the time I show up to class or the shop, I'm already completely drained. 

I mean, I’m still getting by, mostly, but I’ve missed a couple of deadlines lately. I even had to back out of helping with the theater set because I just couldn’t keep everything straight anymore. It's just been a lot to handle.
Do you feel like these changes started because your sister and her baby moved back home?

Yeah, definitely. I was doing okay before my sister and the baby moved in. Everything was pretty normal. But, um, I'd say the trouble really started within a couple weeks of the house getting so crowded.
Since this started, have you been feeling sad or down most days?

Not really sad, no. Um, I wouldn't say I feel down most days. It's more just... I'm stressed and completely drained from all the extra chaos at the house, like I mentioned, but I don't think I'm actually feeling sad.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively, even when you try to stop?

No, not really. I mean, I wouldn't call it worrying. It's just... I'm just overwhelmed with all the noise and the lack of space, you know? But I'm not sitting around worrying about things happening or anything like that.
Since all this started, have you been feeling tense or keyed up a lot of the time?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I don't feel physically tense or anything like that. It's really just the annoyance of the house being so loud and crowded now. I'm just tired from it all, but I'm not walking around feeling on edge or keyed up.
